newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Elec plans Y310 bln of chip output in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Elec plans Y310 bln of chip output in 97/98.

text.p: Sanyo Electric Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans 310 billion yen worth of semiconductor output in the business year from April 1, 1997.
Sanyo also plans to invest 2.5 billion yen in the coming fiscal year in its solar cell business, Sanyo President Yasuaki Takano told reporters.
The 2.5 billion yen investment will be mainly for a new plant to start operations in Los Angeles after October 1997, he said.
He added that Sanyo would invest an additional 10 billion yen between 1998/99 and 2000/01 in the solar cell business.
"We want to increase sales of solar cells to 50 billion yen by the year 2000," he said.
He did not elaborate on what current solar cell sales were.
On semiconductors, Takano said Sanyo's actual chip production in 1996/97 would be worth 280 billion yen.
Sanyo said it would strengthen production of flash memory chips in 1997/98.
